Type: lamp
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Industrial Wall Sconce Light with Clear Glass Shade, 9.5"H, Satin Brass
Colors: Satin Brass
Materials: Glass
Quick installation means that you can easily bring light wherever you need it without adding a lot of extra furniture. The satin brass design of the compact, sturdy metal wall fixture will add a classic touch to any space. Light beams from the elongated clear glass shade, brightening any room. 6.75"W x 9"D x 9.5"H Satin brass wall sconce with 1 light and an elongated clear glass shade This versatile design mixes a touch of the nautical with modern industrial sophistication. Includes 1 LED vintage-style bulb
